mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, John Ehlers' published negative-group-delay Voss Predictor crossing its companion two-pole BandPass on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies a cyclical turning point before the underlying filter; follow the predicted direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long on a strict Voss-over-BandPass crossing; short on a strict Voss-under-BandPass crossing
mechanism.why_distinct: A period-20 bandwidth-.25 recursive BandPass feeds an order-nine weighted autoregressive Voss predictor with predict=3, and the forward-looking field crosses its source filter. It is not a zero crossing, truncated filter, raw price or moving-average crossover, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the predictor targets cyclical turning points and must cross while completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation ranks in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: negative-group-delay predictor-versus-source-filter crossings are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.bandpass: F1=cos(2*pi/Period); G1=cos(Bandwidth*2*pi/Period); S1=1/G1-sqrt(1/G1^2-1); published two-pole recursion on completed close
features.voss: Order=3*Predict; weighted prior Voss sum and published negative-group-delay recursion
features.event: strict finite Voss-minus-BandPass zero crossing relative to immediately prior valid decision
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.recursive_reset: invalid completed four-hour bars reset BandPass and Voss state; initialize recursive outputs to zero; require at least Period uninterrupted observations and finite current/prior fields

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: published Ehlers period-20 predict-3 Voss Predictor versus BandPass crossover under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no period, predict, bandwidth, order, recursion, crossover, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: John F. Ehlers, A Peek Into The Future, TASC August 2019
external_basis.fixed_definition: Period=20, Predict=3, Bandwidth=.25, Order=3*Predict; Filt=.5*(1-S1)*(Close-Close[2])+F1*(1+S1)*Filt[1]-S1*Filt[2]; SumC=sum count 0..Order-1 of ((count+1)/Order)*Voss[Order-count]; Voss=((3+Order)/2)*Filt-SumC; author suggests simple Voss/BandPass crossovers as a trading-system basis
external_basis.selection_use: published parameters, recursions, predictor/source crossover, and natural crossover side only; no incidence or outcomes
